entry.title: 🧩 How to Pass a Request Body in a GET Request? Meet the New HTTP QUERY Method (RFC 10008)
entry.summary:
⚡ A New HTTP Verb for Developers
The QUERY method (RFC 10008, June 2026) finally solves a long-standing pain point: sending complex request bodies safely and cacheably without abusing GET or POST. Because QUERY is safe and idempotent, if a network drop happens, the client can automatically retry the request without risk of duplicating side effects—adding great architectural value. GET /api/products?category=electronics&tags=wireless,sale,new-arrival&price_min=100&price_max=1000&sort=rating_desc&page=2&limit=20&brand=Sony|Samsung&in_stock=true&discount_gte=10 HTTP/1.1 Host: shop.com
Too long → URLs hit browser/server length limits.
Leaky → Query strings show up in logs, browser history, and monitoring tools.
Awkward encoding → Nested conditions (AND/OR) are hard to represent. POST …
